query: 记忆卡片有哪几种生命周期状态？
note: 维度 D（记忆治理）：四种状态名必须同时出现，考的是系统能否召回自己治理层的设计 | UNANSWERABLE BY DESIGN: the four state names live in tool *arguments* (the file the agent wrote), and the index captures tool *results* only — 0 units in the corpus contain even `supersededBy`. Kept as a challenge case because it measures a real coverage gap in the memory layer, not a retrieval failure.

query: 一条记忆被新记忆取代之后，接班人记在哪个字段里？
note: 维度 D：取代关系的字段名，需要把「被取代」接到治理实现上 | UNANSWERABLE BY DESIGN: same cause — the field name was written, never echoed. A memory layer that ignores what the agent writes is blind to its own implementation.
